BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adult family home services; and adding newsections to chapter 70.128 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.128 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall implement, as part of the required trainingand continuing education, food safety training integrated into thecurriculum that meets the standards established by the state board ofhealth pursuant to chapter 69.06 RCW. Individual food handler permitsare not required for persons who successfully complete the training.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.128 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall work with the providers and residentcommunities to develop opportunities for licensing and qualityassurance staff to become familiar with the actual environment and thedaily handson routine of care and services in an adult family home.
